articles.title: ICC preparing to reshape the international cricket calendar for the 2027–31 cycle
articles.summary: The International Cricket Council (ICC) is discussing significant changes to the international cricket calendar for the 2027–31 cycle, with a proposed shift towards more T20 Internationals and fewer bilateral ODI series. These discussions are taking place at the ICC's Cricket Operations Workshop in Dubai this week, with the Future Tours Programme (FTP) expected to be finalized in November. The aim is to give bilateral ODIs greater context while accommodating the growing demand for T20 cricket.

articles.title: Stumped for wood, bamboo bats offer cricket a substitute to leather on willow
articles.summary: Cricket is facing a growing challenge due to the scarcity of traditional willow for bats, exacerbated by climate change and increased global participation. Researchers at the University of Cambridge have proposed bamboo as a sustainable, cheaper, and environmentally friendly alternative. A prototype bamboo bat has demonstrated a noticeable sweet spot and could be a viable option for recreational and school cricket.

articles.title: India vs West Indies: Virat Kohli joins Sachin Tendulkar in passing 15,000 ODI runs as his 55th ton fires India to victory
articles.summary: Virat Kohli smashed an unbeaten 139 off 88 balls, including 10 fours and nine sixes, to lead India to an eight-wicket victory over West Indies in the first ODI. This century marked his 55th in the format and made him the fastest player to reach 15,000 ODI runs, surpassing Sachin Tendulkar's record. Skipper Shubman Gill also contributed a century (110 runs) as India successfully chased down 296 runs.

articles.title: USA National Men's Cricket Team Begins Historic LA28 Journey with USOPC Performance Camp in Colorado Springs
articles.summary: The USA Men's National Cricket Team has commenced a significant preparatory performance camp at the United States Olympic & Paralympic Training Center in Colorado Springs. This initiative marks a crucial step in their journey towards competing in the Lima 2027 Pan American Games and the Los Angeles 2028 Olympic Games. Cricket is set to return to the Olympic program for the first time in 128 years.

articles.title: Kevin Pietersen promises to challenge Brendon McCullum as England white-ball head coach eyes world No 1 ranking
articles.summary: Former England batsman Kevin Pietersen has joined the England white-ball coaching setup, with the stated aim of challenging head coach Brendon McCullum and guiding the team to the world No. 1 ranking. Pietersen's appointment follows England's recent series-clinching victory over Sri Lanka. He expressed his excitement about being back in the dressing room and contributing to the team's success.

articles.title: County Championship: Leicestershire have eight points reinstated from 27-point deduction for poor pitch blamed on Bollywood film shoot
articles.summary: Leicestershire's 27-point deduction in the County Championship, which led to their relegation from Division One, has been partially overturned with eight points reinstated. The Cricket Discipline Panel (CDP) amended the sanction following an appeal, reducing the total deduction to 19 points. The initial penalty was imposed for a substandard pitch at Grace Road.

articles.title: Ravaged by anarchy, West Indies bank on raw talent for ODI series vs India
articles.summary: The West Indies cricket team is relying on raw talent as they prepare for their upcoming ODI series against India, despite a history of administrative challenges and a long drought in bilateral series wins against top teams. Captain Shai Hope acknowledged the team's struggles over the past two decades but emphasized the importance of consistency. The team is looking to improve its standing in international cricket.

articles.title: Asian Games 2026: India qualify for semis as match against Afghanistan abandoned without toss
articles.summary: India has secured a spot in the semifinals of the Asian Games 2026 after their quarter-final cricket match against Afghanistan was abandoned due to rain, without a single ball being bowled. The Shreyas Iyer-led Indian side will now advance to face Pakistan in the semifinals on Thursday. Iyer expressed his honor in leading the team and the pressure to perform at the top level.

articles.title: Ishan Kishan Mammoth 270 Powers East Zone to 708 in Duleep Trophy Final
articles.summary: Ishan Kishan delivered a monumental performance, scoring 270 runs to help East Zone post a massive total of 708 in the Duleep Trophy Final. This outstanding batting display highlights his current form in domestic cricket. The innings was a significant contribution to his team's strong position in the match.

articles.title: BAN vs MAS 4th Quarter Final T20 Match - Live Cricket Score, Full Scorecard, Korogi Sports Park, Nisshin
articles.summary: The 4th Quarter Final T20 match of the Asian Games 2026 is set to take place between Bangladesh and Malaysia at the Korogi Sports Park in Nisshin. Bangladesh, as a full ICC member, has directly qualified for the quarterfinals. Malaysia, having played through earlier stages, enters the match with rhythm, making for an intriguing contest.

articles.title: Injuries deplete Australia further in South Africa
articles.summary: Australia's tour of South Africa has been hit by further injury concerns, with Nathan Ellis and Joel Davies both ruled out of the upcoming third ODI. Ellis suffered a side strain, while Davies sustained a hamstring injury. Five-wicket hero Jack Edwards is also being monitored for a hamstring issue, adding to Australia's challenges as they trail 2-0 in the series.

articles.title: Jemimah Rodrigues to captain Delhi Capitals in WPL 2026
articles.summary: Jemimah Rodrigues is expected to be named the new captain of the Delhi Capitals for the Women's Premier League (WPL) 2026 season. She is among 13 players retained by the franchise ahead of the upcoming auction. This move signifies a focus on an Indian core for the team's leadership.

articles.title: MCC PREPARES FOR NEW EDITION OF LAWS FROM 1 OCTOBER 2026
articles.summary: The Marylebone Cricket Club (MCC) is actively preparing for the implementation of a new edition of the Laws of Cricket, set to come into force on October 1, 2026. This new code introduces 73 material changes, including the legalisation of laminated bats and revised regulations for cricket balls. The MCC is undertaking an extensive educational program, including a new Laws of Cricket app in multiple languages, across India to ensure widespread understanding of the updates.

articles.title: Kohli manifests dream finish for India in CWC Final
articles.summary: Indian batting icon Virat Kohli has expressed his strong desire to play a match-winning, finishing knock for India in the final of the ICC Men's Cricket World Cup 2027. He emphasized his unwavering motivation to win games for his team and his dream of concluding his World Cup career with a significant individual performance in a victorious final.

articles.title: Aussie great steps up as bitter Big Bash battle takes first CA casualty
articles.summary: Former Australian cricketer David Boon has been appointed as the interim chair of Cricket Australia, following the resignation of Mike Baird. Baird's departure comes amidst a contentious dispute within Australian cricket over the proposed privatization of the Big Bash League. Boon will assume his new role at the governing body's annual general meeting.

articles.title: ICC to unveil World Cup 2027 schedule on October 1: report
articles.summary: The International Cricket Council (ICC) and Cricket South Africa (CSA) are reportedly set to announce the full schedule for the 2027 Men's Cricket World Cup on October 1st. This announcement will mark the one-year countdown to the tournament and is expected to coincide with the release of match tickets. The upcoming edition will feature a new three-stage format designed to enhance competitiveness.

articles.title: India Cricket Schedule September 2026: Full List of Matches
articles.summary: India's cricket schedule for September 2026 includes a busy itinerary of six matches across different formats. The team is playing a three-match T20I series against Afghanistan and two One Day Internationals against West Indies. Notably, key players Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma are returning for the ODI series, while Shreyas Iyer is leading the T20I contingent in the Asian Games.
